name: ActiveCampaign Dashboard
description: Adds three read-only admin dashboard pages that list ActiveCampaign campaigns, contacts and lists via the shared activecampaign.api service.
project_description: Submodule of the ActiveCampaign project. Provides three read-only admin dashboard pages under /admin/activecampaign that display ActiveCampaign data pulled live through the parent module's activecampaign.api service: a Campaigns page (name, send date, emails sent, open/click/bounce/unsubscribe rates), a Contacts page (email, first/last name, created date) and a Lists page (name, subscribers, active subscribers). Rows deep-link into the ActiveCampaign app. All three pages are gated by the 'access activecampaign dashboard' permission and use Drupal's core pager (20 rows per page).
